title: in-cosmetics Asia 2026 puts fragrance innovation in the spotlight
summary: As fragrance becomes a key driver of emotional engagement and product differentiation, in-cosmetics Asia will introduce a dedicated Fragrance Zone at its next edition, taking place at BITEC, Bangkok, from 3-5 November 2026. The new feature reflects the expanding role of scent across personal care, homecare and pet care, as brands seek to create more distinctive sensory experiences.
